    • startMatch

      public void startMatch(String mode, String p1Country, String p2Country, String machineProfile, boolean isGoalBased, int targetValue, int fieldWidth, int fieldHeight) throws DopoSoccerException
      Creates a new Match
      Parameters:
      mode - is the gameMode
      p1Country - is the first player country name.
      p2Country - is the second player country name.
      machineProfile - if the gameMode is pvm
      isGoalBased - if the match is by goals.
      targetValue - it represents the value that the user must put, it represents goals or time.
      fieldWidth - width of the field in pixels
      fieldHeight - height of the field in pixels
      Throws:
      DopoSoccerException - - SLOWER_OR_EQUALS_TO_ZERO
